mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, which produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% over three months signals labor market tightening, increasing wage growth and consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) reflects robust household demand, accelerating economic growth and corporate earnings, which produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In an industrial slowdown regime (INDPRO decline), reduced manufacturing output signals economic contraction, prompting risk-averse investor behavior and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates tight labor market conditions, increasing wage pressures and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually signals inflationary pressures, triggering monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 3.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates consumer sector weakness, reducing growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 1.0% and UNRATE rises > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST falls > 1.0% and UNRATE rises > 0.2% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production relative to GDP (INDPRO/GDPC1 ratio) signals an impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors flee risk.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO/GDPC1 ratio falls > 0.5% in 1 month.
